items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They brought a gypsy guy to my hotel and he played this thing for me - Mehau Dresh is his name.

ctx.x: Gypsies! They brought a gypsy guy to my hotel and he played this thing for me - Mehau Dresh is his name. And he played this thing for me. So I fell on the floor and started foamin’ at the mouth and rollin’ around. And he said, “No, it’s our folk instrument. You can’t have one because we don’t let it out of the country.” That kind of thing. It’s a Transylvanian instrument.
